name: DomRide
description: DomRide is a premium ride-sharing platform developed specifically for the Dominican Republic. It features real-time GPS tracking, secure payment integration, and a seamless interface for both riders and drivers. Built with high performance in mind using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, it handles complex socket connections and real-time mapping for a reliable user experience.

name: PlayQue
description: PlayQue is a Productivity app designed to help users track and manage their educational playlists. It solves the common problem of losing track of multi-video learning paths by allowing users to save URLs, track progress percentage, and set daily reminders. It's a full-featured app with offline caching and paging for a smooth experience.

name: DIU Results
description: A dedicated academic portal for Dhaka International University students. This app allows students to instantly check their semester results, view faculty profiles, and connect with batchmates. It features a sophisticated offline caching system that ensures students can access their data even without a stable internet connection.

name: Gooal
description: Gooal provides real-time updates for football fans worldwide. Covering all major leagues, the app offers live scores, match highlights, and personalized notifications for goals and match events. It leverages cloud functions and robust APIs to ensure data is updated within seconds of the actual event.

name: MVP Chat App
description: A modern real-time messaging application built with a focus on speed and privacy. It utilizes Supabase for authentication and database management, with Hilt for dependency injection. The app supports media sharing using CameraX and provides a smooth typing experience with Coroutines and Flow.

name: Prayer Times
description: A utility app for accurate prayer times and Qibla direction based on the user's location. Built with a clean UI using Tailwind CSS principles, it allows users to stay connected with their daily routines effortlessly.

name: Loveria
description: A lifestyle and relationship app that uses fun algorithms to calculate compatibility and share results with friends. Designed with a vibrant UI to engage younger audiences.
